description: This file defines API endpoints related to customer orders in a FastAPI web application. It provides functions for listing orders and retrieving detailed information about a specific order, utilizing dependency injection for database session and current customer, and calling an OrderService to handle business logic.

methods.name: list_orders( current_customer: Customer = Depends(get_current_customer), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to list all orders for the authenticated customer, returning an OrderListResponse with the list and count.

methods.name: get_order_detail( order_id: int, current_customer: Customer = Depends(get_current_customer), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to retrieve detailed information of a specific order by ID for the authenticated customer, returning an OrderDetailResponse.

ctags.signature: ( order_id: int, current_customer: Customer = Depends(get_current_customer), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
